svg.title: A recursive CTE walks a hierarchy one level per pass
svg.desc: The base case selects Sandra at depth 0, with no manager. Pass 1 joins employees to the rows the previous pass found, matching manager_id to employee_id 1: Marcus and Priya, depth 1, whose manager_name is Sandra. Pass 2 matches ids 2 and 3 and finds Tom and Elena, depth 2, managed by Marcus. Pass 3 matches ids 4 and 5 and finds Wade, depth 3, managed by Tom. Pass 4 looks for manager_id 6, finds no rows, and recursion stops. UNION ALL stacks every pass into the result: Sandra (no manager, 0), Marcus (Sandra, 1), Priya (Sandra, 1), Tom (Marcus, 2), Elena (Marcus, 2), Wade (Tom, 3).
svg.text: A recursive CTE walks a hierarchy one level per pass
Each pass joins employees to the rows the previous pass found. That row (r) supplies the manager's name.
the name on the row the

CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS manager_name, 0 AS depth
INNER JOIN reports_to_sandra r ON e.manager_id = r.employee_id
SELECT name, manager_name, depth FROM reports_to_sandra
